description.value: This study investigated gray- and white-matter morphometric differences between patients with alcohol dependence and controls, and examined relationships between regional tissue density, drinking history, and neuropsychological performance.

spans.text: Here we reanalyze the brain abnormalities in individuals with alcohol dependence, using a voxel-based analysis of segmented magnetic resonance images, and investigate which specific cortical regions correlate with drinking history and neuropsychological executive function performance.
